e: A 2-year post to develop the plasma injector for PETRA IV: review the X-band dechirper design, test X-band hardware and build a prototype energy compressor for GeV-class laser-plasma-accelerated electron beams. Requires a PhD in physics with accelerator physics and RF experience; no citizenship limit stated.
n: DESY: Accelerator Scientist, X-band technology and energy compression (PETRA IV)
